name: smwsprites-p-ring
title: P-Ring
description:
(Based on the Blue Ring of NSLU)

Unlike as a p-switch you neend't hit it at the top and you can actived by going (or running) through it, so it's good for levels where you must almost run the whole time.

You needn't give credits.

Now SA-1 hybrid. There were also two .asm files, one depending on extra bit and the other on the X position: only the former has been kept because of practicality.
